method: Production-WASM stability/curve outputs; exact extracted Rust normal_slope_at_mach over reconstructed positive-only flight-preparation inputs; separate TS load oracle at matched states.

conventions.note: Mach/AoA states are controlled local conditions, not a simulated attainable trajectory; curves expose no AoA argument. CP-only moment substitution holds flight slope/drag/CG fixed and is not a replacement model.
